samples.summaryVi: Giờ linh hoạt giúp cân bằng trách nhiệm; cần khoảng giờ chung và biết ai đang có mặt.

paragraphs.label: Cảm ơn
paragraphs.text:
Hi Alex,

I am writing to thank you for helping me prepare for a flexible working discussion. It was kind of you to give up part of your weekend, and I really appreciate the time you spent checking the plan with me.
paragraphs.noteVi: Nêu hành động được giúp và sự trân trọng.

paragraphs.label: Tác dụng
paragraphs.text: Your suggestions helped us compare working schedules and plan shared team hours without rushing through the instructions. You also reminded me to prepare a sample weekly schedule. That small detail made the session easier to organise, and I felt much more confident when the other participants arrived.
paragraphs.noteVi: Dùng chi tiết để lời cảm ơn cụ thể.

paragraphs.label: Điều học được
paragraphs.text: The discussion was useful because employees can organise work around practical personal needs. One example that stayed with me was this: a parent can start earlier on two days so that they can collect a child from school. I would not have had as much time to listen and learn if I had still been struggling with the preparations on my own.
paragraphs.noteVi: Giờ linh hoạt giúp cân bằng trách nhiệm; cần khoảng giờ chung và biết ai đang có mặt.

paragraphs.label: Đáp lại
paragraphs.text:
I would like to take you out for lunch next weekend as a small way of saying thank you. Please tell me which day would suit you. Thanks again for being so supportive.

Best wishes,
Minh
